subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow facts should OpenClaw show directly to end users, and how should session or channel identifiers be redacted?
rationale: Current code already carries provider/model, token, budget, route, and session facts, but exposing exact counts and identifiers changes privacy and support behavior that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Show Redacted Diagnostics
options.body: Expose provider/model, effective context budget or model limit, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted channel/session label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

options.title: Keep Specifics Operator-Only
options.body: Leave chat copy generic and document the log, status, or diagnostics path operators should use for detailed context-pressure facts.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Context Visibility
options.body: Defer this issue until a broader context-visibility design decides shared UI, logs, status, and channel-message behavior together.

recommendation.title: Show Redacted Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose provider/model, effective context budget or model limit, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted channel/session label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main and prior-review signal on the agent/runtime diagnostic policy surface.
